title: OEM and instrument integration
tables: Instrument manufacturers, automation integrators, incubator vendors, LIMS providers and consumables partners.
Useful laboratory components often operate as isolated products with proprietary interfaces.
BAHU adapter SDK; API gateway; device identity; event schema; PIMS; simulator; conformance tests.
Define partner interface -> sandbox/simulate -> map commands/events/data -> validate failure modes -> certify adapter version -> deploy with monitoring.
Interoperable workflow node, traceable device events and partner-specific configuration package.
Lets AMR-Eye become an orchestration layer and modular platform instead of requiring every component to be built in-house.

Commercial agreements, cybersecurity, liability, interface stability, service ownership and joint validation are required. Integration does not transfer one device's regulatory status to the combined system.
